I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I confirmed Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 25 November. I also told her that, for now, her message is the only record of that date, because I had nowhere else to save it.

- **No account files:** I found no Brackenwater account folder, and no account folders at all, that I could update.
- **gbrain is refusing every request:** it rejected my search with "requester_scope_required" because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. Someone needs to fix this on the brain host. Its suggested command is `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`. Since this is a shared bot, the other option is `--may-act-for <members>`, with the bot naming the member on each request. Until then I can't check or store anything in the brain.

I didn't do anything else. The renewal date isn't a money term, so sharing it in the channel is fine.
